A conversation-care release: answers translate in place, questions become editable and manageable without leaving the chat, and long conversations get proper navigation.

## 🌐 Translate answers in place
A translate button on every answer — pick a target language, watch paragraphs spin in place, and the finished translation replaces the answer inline (no popup). The choice is remembered per answer; "Original" in the menu restores it.

## ✏️ Edit and manage your questions
Hover a question for copy / edit / delete. Edit reopens it as an in-place white input card — sending replaces the old exchange entirely, so history never duplicates. Only the most recent question is editable; every delete asks for confirmation.

## 🧭 Reading & navigation polish
Floating scroll-to-bottom button for long conversations; home screen spacing now matches onboarding; accent-colored text selection; the community invite points to the new Discord server.

## ⚙️ Settings, aligned
Every settings tab uses the Model tab's full-width layout — tab bar and content cards share the same edges. The ✨ badge disappears once your license is active; the status bar shows just the note count.

## 💾 Storage housekeeping
The one-time pre-migration database backup (~400 MB) is auto-deleted after the migration has been healthy for 3 days, guarded by a live-slot integrity check.

## 🧰 Developer tooling (semlink-debug MCP)
Screen recording rebuilt on WebCodecs VP9 with the real pointer drawn onto every frame (flight animation + click ripples); capture survives window occlusion; `bitrate` / `zoom` are parameters and `status` reports `actualFps`. New `session` tool; `ui` gains scroll / hover / keyboard / hidden-element queries; `chatview` exposes the citation registry.

## 🌍 i18n
11 new UI strings translated across all 10 language packs.

**Download**: Obsidian community plugin store, or <https://github.com/ouou365/Semlink/releases/tag/2.3.0>
